title: Profile decomposition gates
statement: Let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be finite and let $a\colon\mathbb{N}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a sign sequence. Define a family of $2n$ Boolean functions indexed by pairs $(i,r)$ with $0\le i<n$ and $r\in\{0,1\}$: for $r=0$ use the profile main gate at $i$, and for $r=1$ use the profile correction gate at $i$.
